description: This file defines an abstract factory class for recovery modes in Spark's standalone deployment, along with concrete implementations for filesystem, RocksDB, and ZooKeeper recovery strategies, including methods for creating persistence engines and leader election agents.

classes.name: StandaloneRecoveryModeFactory
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for recovery mode factories, including methods to create persistence engines and leader election agents.

classes.name: FileSystemRecoveryModeFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of recovery mode using filesystem, restoring from directory with optional compression codec.

classes.name: RocksDBRecoveryModeFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of recovery mode using RocksDB for persistence.

classes.name: ZooKeeperRecoveryModeFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of recovery mode using ZooKeeper for persistence and leader election.

methods.name: createPersistenceEngine
methods.description: Abstract method to create a persistence engine for recovery data.

methods.name: createLeaderElectionAgent
methods.description: Abstract method to create a leader election agent.
